title: Exchange Listing Standards Baseline
source_citation: Generic quantitative/distribution/governance listing-standards criteria shape common across exchange listing rulebooks; numeric thresholds are venue-specific and caller-supplied, not embedded here.

steps.title: Confirm minimum market capitalization
steps.instruction: Confirm measured market capitalization (USD millions) meets or exceeds the applicable minimum market cap threshold for this listing venue.

steps.title: Confirm minimum public float
steps.instruction: Confirm measured public float percentage meets or exceeds the applicable minimum public float threshold for this listing venue.

steps.title: Confirm minimum price
steps.instruction: Confirm measured price (USD) meets or exceeds the applicable minimum price threshold for this listing venue.

steps.title: Confirm minimum holder/distribution count
steps.instruction: Confirm measured holder count meets or exceeds the applicable minimum holder count threshold for this listing venue.

steps.title: Confirm independent board majority
steps.instruction: Confirm the board has an independent-director majority as required by the applicable listing venue.

steps.title: Confirm audit committee is present
steps.instruction: Confirm an audit committee meeting the applicable listing venue's composition requirements is in place.
